## Project Details
- **Type**: React Native Mobile App (Expo)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Database**: SQLite (expo-sqlite)
- **UI Framework**: React Native Paper
- **Navigation**: React Navigation

## Features
- Group creation and management
- Player management (Name, Grade Level: Beginner/Intermediate/Professional)
- Smart shuffle algorithm (4 players per court, balanced by grade levels)
- Badminton court visualization
